# NONoise

> AI SDLC bootstrapper. The `create-nonoise` CLI scaffolds projects with AI skills, a docs hierarchy, per-tool context files and the Polly orchestrator, and upgrades existing ones.

## For agents asked to install or update NONoise in a project

- [UPDATE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/UPDATE.md): step-by-step runbook (detect case, `npx create-nonoise@latest --upgrade <path>`, `doctor`, post-upgrade steps; the upgrade installs the `codebase-memory-mcp` code graph and retires graphify)

## Docs

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/installation.md): prerequisites, native vendors, the `codebase-memory-mcp` code graph (`--code-graph-only`), Haft, profiles
- [Install profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/install-profiles.md)
- [Development modes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/development-modes.md): quick / medium / long (`/polly quick|medium|long <goal>`), the FPF gate, Regia compatibility, Codex and Copilot
- [Contributor guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/CLAUDE.md)
